archive_rules: Preserve original file bytes, modes and relative mapping; do not load weights
No ELF, AGENTS or license entries; original .pt/.bin are training-data artifacts, not executable packages
Deterministic tar metadata in separate provenance fields; never change originals
After root grant: stream from original paths, verify source hash/mode before/after, independently verify archive member byte/mode/size manifests without altering evidence
Keep old archive and failed approaches; no deletion or replacement
Do not infer acceptance from matching deterministic synthetic results
future_t200_v4_compare: Use full prior v3 t200 checkpoint/export bytes and emitted losses in this plan as read-only reference; preserve v3controllerFAIL.
priority: S11 B native has disk priority. Do not create archive or copy weights until root grants after disk restoration. NoTorch until a further exact root grant even if disk restores.
scope: Every path under both original full runtime trees and outer evidence trees, plus exact launch source/index/protocol/grants. Remaining4 includes t300/t400/t500 staged inputs explicitly NOT_RUN.
